scope: Control-extended conditional estimate; C639 transfer, not complete physical-chip power
assumptions: Existing v2 terms, DDR and frozen token times are preserved. SiLU/G32 and original SRAM transactions are already counted.
RMS uses N + scan + chunked apply; apply contains E32. RoPE contains its E32. Neither adds standalone E32 again.
Native activity ranges are sampled endpoints, not statistical confidence intervals.
Unbound arithmetic uses E32 S32 product and U ADD2 scalar energy as proxies; floating arithmetic transfer multiplier is an assumed 0.5x to 2x sensitivity.
Each EXP/tanh/softplus proxy assumes 4 to 12 multiply-plus-add stages; reciprocal/rsqrt assumes 4 to 16 such stages. These are cost scenarios, not verified approximations or error guarantees.
Router compare/select uses an ADD2 energy proxy and e*k work count; sorting implementation is not synthesized.

Additional arithmetic idle sensitivity: zero with ideal gating to 4 E32 + 4 RMS N + 4 scan + 4 apply wrappers + 1 RoPE wrapper + 1 softmax module, each counted once. This is a conditional common footprint, not a frozen deployment.
Large-vector staging sensitivity: zero additional copies to two 128-bit reads plus two writes per RMS word. Existing TLM SRAM work is not re-added.
FP32/RTL equivalence, overflow, revised timing and model accuracy are unverified for proxies. Energy scenarios do not fix the E32 9/18-cycle schedule discrepancy.
not_included: Mother image-install/sequence/cohort grant wrappers and packet bridges outside the calibrated core; unsampled startup states and exact state residency.
Per-model router registry differences, actual instance/clock gating, global clock and inter-block physical interconnect.
Read DMA idle/leakage and calibrated dynamic power; DDR PHY/package/board I/O. Read DMA dynamic proxy remains a separate scenario.
Matched special-operator RTL numerical/power acceptance, old M timing closure and E32 9/18 cycle calibration; wire parasitics intentionally excluded.
control_assumptions: Actual C639 reference has STALL_LIMIT=4096 and SERVICE_STALL_LIMIT=2000000; replace previous 4096 service-timeout core reference.
Core power range includes two startup and six runtime windows and is applied once over the frozen duration. Startup is not added again; exact per-state residency is not measured.

Four cut LC shells plus four actual C639 routers are assumed clocked for the full window. PM arrays and descriptor-fetch children are excluded. Per-model router registries and physical deployment remain unverified.

Static control-page instruction counts reconcile to frozen calls/pages. One PM read per compact instruction, no fetch cache; four-flit CALL plus four-flit successful terminal. Cancellation/retry traffic is excluded.
PM runtime reads use the accepted four-macro conditional clock energy (one addressed 128-bit control word). This is separate from the 512-bit data SRAM and does not change its width.
Switch sampling has 19 interior accepted flits and 20 inclusive driver events; the triggering initial edge has no pre-edge VCD snapshot. Denominators 19-20 are included in coefficient sensitivity.
All intervals are sampled coefficient/scenario endpoints, not confidence intervals or guaranteed error bounds. No wire RC is loaded.
